name: resistance band explosive push up
description: A push-up with a band across your back and a fast push at the top. It trains explosive chest and triceps power.
instructions: Loop the band across your upper back and hold the ends under your palms.
Set up in a push-up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest to the floor with control.
Push up hard so your hands briefly leave the floor.
Land softly with elbows slightly bent.
